scene: The poked urchin shoots dazzling sparkles, unveiling three waiting transit stations.
picture: Flat side view along a glowing stone pier. At far left stands a frosted sleigh tram on ice rails. The boy in orange puffer vest stands left of centre watching a tethered striped balloon basket in the centre. Far right sits a yellow chairlift station with an empty hanging bench.
shown: a frosted glass sleigh tram idling on rails at the far left
a tethered striped hot-air balloon with open wicker gate at the centre
an empty swinging yellow double chairlift bench waiting at the far right
